denominator_scope.episodes: ended native episodes = failures + successes + timeouts; not actor updates

limitations: Stochastic training with resets/DR/physical prefix; not a deterministic mean-policy rollout.
Behavior float32 event means are differenced with native integer frame counts; lifetime maxima cannot yield interval extrema.
Recovery static group names do not identify dynamically sampled lesson levels.
Lesson cumulative counters are 24-frame rollout averages; their endpoint differences are not exact episode integers.
Completed stationary windows need2s quiet then10s with height error<=10mm; anchors can precede this actor window; target need not stay fixed.
Missing observations are unavailable, never imputed zero; zero completed stationary samples provide no stationary success evidence.
Ten critic-only collections remain in native cumulative frame denominators, but the selected dense intervals and reported task actor endpoints exclude those updates.
Static group command means cannot certify L0-specific nonzero goal exposure; actual L0 motion release and exposure are unavailable in this event schema.
Source023 sets recovery entropy coefficient to zero and charges ten critic adaptation updates; this stochastic window is descriptive, not causal or functional qualification.
No v25 PPO yet; this is unchanged source023 REC.
L0/L1/L2 averaged counter deltas are not integer ended episodes; full-chain instantaneous fraction is not completed-chain rate.
Training behavior statistics include Gaussian exploration and domain randomization; deterministic deployment quality remains unassessed.
comparison_scope: Adjacent nonoverlapping100 stochastic training windows; same frozen source and mature course shares, different random rollouts/DR, not a causal or qualification comparison.
posture_scope: Native group maxima are since observer birth; current-window mean/separated pitch-roll angles are unavailable. Reward densities do not supply measured posture angles.

posture_reward_densities.scope: Reward densities/costs, not measured pitch/roll angles.
